issues.display_title: Issue #1556: [Foundation][Integration] ThemeService + dark/light theme toggle

Implement dark/light theme switching driven by a ThemeService.

Scope

Goal

Deconstruct create-exhibition.component.ts (597 lines) by extracting the complex sequential upload data manipulation logic and the 3D rendering computation (BabylonJS) into a dedicated service. The goal is to make the main component cleaner, focusing solely on managing the UI wizard state.

  • The component listens for the Promise result. If successful -> moves to the Preview state; if failed -> displays an error and restores the state.

  2. The 3D model (.glb) scaling dimensions can still be extracted accurately.
